targets.suggestedAction: Open Feather/HVAC or String List details and inspect affected device.

recommendedActions: Check temperature thermistor harness seating on both module and BPC ends.
Verify temperature harness is free of pin-pin shorts and physical damage.
Inspect BPC temperature sensor ports.
If values read exactly -40C or 150C, replace the sensor harness or BPC (open/short circuit detection).
validationChecks: Measure resistance across thermistor pins (NTC standard curve).
Confirm that surrounding cells do not show identical thermal spikes.
clearingCriteria: All thermal readings return within valid operational boundaries (e.g., 15C to 45C).
replacementGuidance: Verify thermistor harness seating and measure resistance values.
escalationGuidance: Read telemetry temperature channels. An open circuit reads minimum scale (-40C); a short circuit reads full scale (150C). Use this to trace harness/connector integrity.
